author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp.SAFER — minimal F# full-stack starter (Tiny Chat demo)
description: Minimal F# full-stack starter for the ToolUp Platform SDK. Mirrors the SAFE Stack get-started experience and demonstrates the in-tree Elmish + ToolUp.Remoting fork primitives via a Tiny Chat demo. Anonymous mode, in-memory only, no auth, no persistence. For production multi-tenant + auth + persistence, use platformsdk-solution. Note: pass `-o <Name>` with a CamelCase or alphanumeric name; hyphenated names diverge between filenames (raw) and .sln project refs (id-safe form).

toolUpSdkVersion.description: ToolUp.* SDK version (drives every transitive ToolUp.* package version via $(ToolUpSdkVersion) in Directory.Packages.props).

skipRestore.description: If true, skip dotnet restore after scaffolding.
